record.question: Blue Mountains
record.explanation: Answer A: Nilgiri Hills. Nilgiri means Blue Mountains. The Tourism Ministry’s original Nilgiris destination plan gives that English translation and identifies the range across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Kerala. Historical/source note: Name translation and stable geography; modern district count in the later plan is not used for 2018. Reference: https://sd2.tourism.gov.in/DocumentRepoFiles/MasterPlan/MPac06c898-e255-4a17-9d57-8eef46b307cb.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
